title: My Old Phone
sentences: My phone is four years old and very slow.
It takes a long time to open my messages.
The battery only lasts until the afternoon.
I carry a charger with me everywhere.
Last week the screen stopped working for a minute.
I was afraid that I would lose all my photos.
My brother says I should buy a new one.
New phones are expensive, so I am saving money.
For now I turn it off at night to save the battery.
It still works, and I do not need anything special.
